name: theme-zero-css
description: Theme zero as a stylesheet: the --ui-* token layer (light and dark, following prefers-color-scheme) plus the Tailwind v4 @theme block that maps every utility the components use onto it. The install path that works without npm (issue #30) — generated from @bydiorama/tokens' toTailwindTheme() and toCss(), the same output Storybook renders against, and kept fresh by `pnpm check:theme-css`. Import it once after `@import "tailwindcss";`. A brand theme is not this file: run the emitters (resolveThemePair → toCss) with the brand's seed instead.
